description: This file defines extension methods for IServiceCollection to configure dependency injection for the Conduit project, including services for MediatR, validation, AutoMapper, authentication via JWT, and logging with Serilog.

classes.name: ServicesExtensions
classes.description: Static class providing extension methods for IServiceCollection to register application services, JWT authentication, and logging.

methods.name: AddConduit
methods.description: Registers core application services including MediatR handlers, validation, AutoMapper, and scoped services like password hashing, token generation, user context, and profile reading.

methods.name: AddJwt
methods.description: Configures JWT Bearer authentication, setting token validation parameters, issuer, audience, and handling token extraction from Authorization header.

methods.name: AddSerilogLogging
methods.description: Sets up Serilog as the logging framework with console sink, verbose level, and enriches logs with context.
